messages:
nina: Quick sync: I’m drafting release notes for the docs site covering SDK rename + anchor reorg. Need owners for JS/Python snippets and a short known-issues list.
raf: I’ll take JS snippets. Where are the old init examples?
nina: docs/sdk/js/overview.md and samples/quickstart-js.md. Also some whats-new anchors moved after the headings restructure. docs-bot flagged some.
docs-bot: linkcheck: 7 failed anchors, 2 external 404s. Full log attached to PR 6224.
corey: For Python, we changed resp.text -> resp.output.text and max_len -> max_tokens. I recommend showing a tiny compatibility snippet instead of duplicating full examples.
raf: Agreed. I’ll update JS to use `new Redwood()` and add a short migration note referencing the migration guide. PR 6230.
eng-runtime: Heads-up: streaming fallback behavior changed; include a note in the whats-new that streaming may produce partial chunks in some APAC zones. We’re tracking infra ticket INF-998.
qa-sam: Tag me when PRs are ready. I’ll run smoke tests on dedicated staging. Please include staging links and a short test plan (two requests: generate short, generate long)
nina: Draft changelog bullets: - SDK: client class rename and parameter updates (see migration guide) - Docs: anchor restructure + redirect fixes - Known issue: embeddings streaming partials in APAC - Note: legacy alias retained for one release
corey: Added Python compatibility snippet in PR 6234. It shows new + legacy alias with a callout: "Deprecated shim retained for one release"
raf: Merged JS snippets PR 6230; linkcheck updated.
docs-bot: deploy: whats-new staging build queued.
qa-sam: Smoke tests scheduled tomorrow 09:00 PT. Will post results here.
nina: Plan: merge snippet + anchor PRs, QA signoff, then publish whats-new and changelog. ETA EOD Thursday. Thanks all!
